(2) By m eans of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following relief:
 "(i) I ssue a writ, order or
direction in the nature of m andam us
directing the respondents to constitute
an independent I nquiry Com m ittee for
fixing the responsibilities of the
authorities/ doctors of the Govt. Medical
College, Haldwani, who were responsible
for the incident dated 8th July 2013,
which has caused loss of a child to the
petitioner as well as due to the negligent
action the petitioner would never
becom e m other in her entire life."
(3) According to petitioner, due to
negligence of doctors of Governm ent
Medical College, Haldwani, she not only
lost her unborn child but her uterus was
also rem oved. As a consequence, she will
not be able to give birth to any child.
Thus she has sought a direction to the
authorities to constitute an independent
inquiry com m ittee for fixing the
responsibility upon the doctors.
(4) Learned State Counsel,

however, subm its that a four-m em ber
inquiry com m ittee was constituted, which
gave its report, in which the doctors
attending the petitioner were given clean
chit. He thus subm its that prayer for
holding further inquiry into the m atter
cannot be granted and if petitioner is
aggrieved in any m anner, then she has
liberty to approach the appropriate forum
under Consum er Protection Act, 2019.
(5) This Court finds substance in
the subm ission of learned State Counsel.
If there is any deficiency in service, then
a person aggrieved can approach District
Consum er Com m ission or State
Consum er Com m issioner, as the case
m ay be. Thus the relief claim ed in the
writ petition cannot be granted.
Accordingly, writ petition fails and is
dism issed.
